t: This is the Church of the Annunciation at Marble Arch, a Church of England parish church dedicated to the Annunciation to the Blessed Virgin Mary. It's a Gothic revival building, designed by Sir Walter Tapper and built in 1912 to 1913, and it's Grade Two star listed. Buried here is Vice-Admiral Sir George Warrender, seventh baronet, who was a senior Royal Navy officer during the First World War. He died in 1917.
